snippet.title: [TRAILER] Rex & Moles - The Unearthing / Reksio i Kretes - Odkop
snippet.description:
Trailer for the about to be realeased demo of "Rex & Moles - The Unearthing" ("Reksio i Kretes - Odkop"), tribute to "Adventures of Rex" P&C game series. If you wish to observe the project, follow me on my Twitter: https://twitter.com/Fox_Centurion

Music: https://www.youtube.com/c/KretKretesRecords
